name: Two essays on Google Docs
notes: Two different essays both live on docs.google.com. Grouping by host would wrongly merge them; the topic words (Gatsby vs Cold War) must win.
Gatsby: two docs, a study guide, a search, and a chapter summary.
Cold War: the paper, a sources sheet, History.com, Wikipedia, JSTOR, and a search. Berlin Wall and Cuban Missile Crisis never say 'Cold War' but are clearly part of it.
An untitled doc and two single class pages are not enough to form sections, so they go to Misc with Spotify and Instagram.
